capabilityTruthMatrix.feature: Single Source of Truth Spatial World State & Event Sourcing
capabilityTruthMatrix.truthRationale: All physical entities, facilities, equipment, and building elements exist in one shared 3D coordinate system with persistent state and hash validation.
capabilityTruthMatrix.verificationEvidence: HermesLiveHouseEngine.computeHash and event stream in state.events

capabilityTruthMatrix.feature: Multi-Factor Autonomous Task Graph & Prioritization Engine
capabilityTruthMatrix.truthRationale: Task execution selects candidate tasks dynamically using dependency readiness, downstream unblocking count, risk severity, and customer gate weights.

capabilityTruthMatrix.feature: Embodied Agent Spatial Trajectories & On-Site Deployment
capabilityTruthMatrix.truthRationale: Agents have physical positions, move to task work locations during execution, and report operational status in event payloads.

capabilityTruthMatrix.feature: Physical Construction Equipment Lifecycle & Spatial Staging
capabilityTruthMatrix.truthRationale: Total stations, drill rigs, excavators, and concrete pumps are tracked with depot locations, clearance radii, and on-site operational states.
capabilityTruthMatrix.verificationEvidence: equipmentEntities in state with active deployment to work location

capabilityTruthMatrix.feature: Material Batch Procurement, Laydown Staging & Installation Tracking
capabilityTruthMatrix.truthRationale: Rebar, concrete, tendons, and formwork are staged physically in the laydown yard with suppliers and quantity tracking before transition to installed components.

capabilityTruthMatrix.feature: Real 3D Bounding-Box Clash Detection & Dynamic Auto-Repair Injection
capabilityTruthMatrix.truthRationale: Clash engine performs 3D bounding box intersection tests between disciplines and dynamically spawns high-priority repair tasks in the graph.

capabilityTruthMatrix.feature: Deterministic ASCE 7-22 / FBC 2023 Wind Load & Tributary Calculations
capabilityTruthMatrix.truthRationale: Wind velocity pressures and tributary wall loads are calculated using code formulas for standard low-rise residential geometry; full 3D finite element analysis is simulated.
capabilityTruthMatrix.verificationEvidence: structuralEngineering object in state with q_z and utilization ratio

capabilityTruthMatrix.feature: Soil Stratification & SPT Penetration Resistance Analysis
capabilityTruthMatrix.truthRationale: Soil class and bearing capacities are derived from Florida geological regional profiles and fixture calibrations; continuous multi-layer soil borehole logs are simulated.

capabilityTruthMatrix.feature: Concrete Hydration Curing, Thermal Transfer & Slump Physics
capabilityTruthMatrix.truthRationale: Basic curing periods and strength progression are parameterized based on mix design; full thermodynamic hydration modeling is simulated.
capabilityTruthMatrix.verificationEvidence: State parameters and schedule duration derivations

capabilityTruthMatrix.feature: ROS2 / Direct Actuator & Hydraulic Hardware Control
capabilityTruthMatrix.truthRationale: Hermes generates spatial waypoints and toolpath envelopes ready for robotic equipment teleoperation, but real hardware CAN bus drivers are planned.

capabilityTruthMatrix.feature: Licensed Professional Engineer Electronic Seal & Municipal AHJ Approval
capabilityTruthMatrix.truthRationale: Hermes performs deterministic automated checks against FBC 2023; legal PE seal of record requires independent licensed human professional review.
